title: Darwix Capital SME Credit Policy & Underwriting Guidelines
content:
Darwix Capital SME Credit Policy & Underwriting Guidelines
Document Reference: POL-UW-2026-v2.1
Effective Date: 2026-01-15
Author: Credit Risk Committee

title: Section 1: Minimum Borrower Qualification Criteria
content:
# Section 1: Minimum Borrower Qualification Criteria

To qualify for an unsecured SME Working Capital Loan or Growth Facility, the applicant business must meet the following mandatory baseline thresholds:

1. **Operating History**: The business entity must have been registered and actively operating for a minimum of 12 consecutive months. Startups under 12 months require a secured asset-backed pledge or a creditworthy corporate guarantor.
2. **Revenue Requirements**: Minimum verified average monthly revenue of $15,000 over the preceding 6 months (supported by official business bank statements or VAT filings).
3. **Credit Profile**: Principal director or guarantor must possess a minimum credit bureau score of 620 with no active bankruptcies, court judgments, or defaults in the trailing 24 months.
4. **Geography & Registration**: Must be a legally registered business entity (LLC, Corporation, or Registered Sole Proprietorship) operating within approved jurisdictions.

title: Section 2: Loan Amounts, Tenors, and Pricing Structure
content:
# Section 2: Loan Amounts, Tenors, and Pricing Structure

- **Working Capital Express**:
 - Facility Size: $10,000 to $100,000
 - Tenor: 3 to 18 months
 - Repayment Frequency: Weekly or Monthly ACH / direct debit
 - Nominal Interest Rate: 1.25% - 2.10% per month (effective APR 15% - 25.2%)
 - Origination Fee: 3.0% deducted at disbursement

- **SME Growth Expansion Loan**:
 - Facility Size: $100,000 to $500,000
 - Tenor: 12 to 36 months
 - Repayment Frequency: Monthly amortized
 - Nominal Interest Rate: 0.95% - 1.50% per month
 - Origination Fee: 2.5% deducted at disbursement

title: Section 3: Early Repayment & Pre-termination Policy
content:
# Section 3: Early Repayment & Pre-termination Policy

Borrowers may repay their loan in full at any time prior to the maturity date.
- **Prepayment Penalty**: Zero penalty for early repayment after 6 months of on-time payments.
- If prepayment occurs within the first 6 months, a flat administrative rebate adjustment fee of 1.5% of the remaining principal balance applies.
- Interest is charged only on the pro-rated period during which capital was deployed.

title: Objection 1: "Why is your Nominal Interest Rate higher than traditional tier-1 commercial banks?"
content:
## Objection 1: "Why is your Nominal Interest Rate higher than traditional tier-1 commercial banks?"
**Response & Grounded Rationale**:
Traditional commercial banks typically advertise nominal rates of 7% - 10% APR, but their qualification process requires physical real estate collateral, audited financial statements for 3+ years, and approval turnaround cycles of 60 to 90 days with high rejection rates (>75% for small businesses).
Darwix Capital provides **unsecured financing** (no real estate collateral required), automated underwriting based on real-time cash flow and bank statements, and funds disbursed directly to your operating account within **24 to 48 hours**. We solve urgent liquidity needs where timing is critical.

title: Objection 2: "Do I need to pledge my home or commercial property as collateral?"
content:
## Objection 2: "Do I need to pledge my home or commercial property as collateral?"
**Response & Grounded Rationale**:
No. Our Working Capital Express and SME Growth facilities are **100% unsecured** regarding physical assets. We do not place liens on your personal residential property. We require only a standard corporate resolution and a principal director's personal guarantee to ensure business commitment.

title: Objection 3: "Are there hidden fees or surprise charges?"
content:
## Objection 3: "Are there hidden fees or surprise charges?"
**Response & Grounded Rationale**:
Darwix Capital operates on complete fee transparency. There are only two fee components:
1. The agreed nominal interest rate stated clearly in your term sheet.
2. A one-time origination processing fee (between 2.5% and 3.0%) which is deducted directly at disbursement.
There are zero application fees, zero monthly maintenance fees, and zero prepayment penalties if the loan is paid off after 6 months.

title: FAQ 4: "What happens if my business revenue temporarily dips?"
content:
## FAQ 4: "What happens if my business revenue temporarily dips?"
**Response & Grounded Rationale**:
Borrowers in good standing who face temporary cash flow seasonality may request a payment relief restructuring or a temporary tenor extension by notifying their account manager at least 10 business days prior to the next billing cycle.

title: Branch Partnership Benefits
content:
Branch Partnership Benefits 
 Operational, marketing, and technology support is provided to branch partners. Partners gain access to our proprietary underwriting portal, co-branded loan origination collateral, automated commission settlement within 7 business days, and dedicated relationship manager escalations. 
 Authorized brokers and bank referral partners receive up to 1.75% trailing origination commission on every successfully disbursed enterprise SME facility.
